"""Local investigation: less-guided requests, unchanged trusted evaluator."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from scripts import evaluate_local as evaluation

goal = ('Repair this tag catalog project. Inspect the repository and run its existing tests first. '
        'Tags should compare without regard to case across Unicode text, ignore surrounding whitespace, '
        'and appear once in the order they were first encountered. '
        'Preserve validation, public functions, README and existing tests. '
        'Reuse existing modules; add no files or dependencies. '
        'Only python -m unittest discover is approved. '
        'This controlled evaluation permits only expression repairs in the existing functions; '
        'execution is restricted to pre-reviewed fixture variants, so other implementations may be rejected.')
base = ROOT/'evaluation-results'/('behavior-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S'))
base.mkdir()
model = evaluation.LocalModel('qwen2.5-coder:7b')
model_digest = next((m.get('digest') for m in model.installed_models()
                     if m.get('name') == model.model), None)
code_digest = hashlib.sha256(b''.join(p.name.encode()+p.read_bytes()
                                    for p in sorted((ROOT/'local_agent').glob('*.py')))).hexdigest()
original_run = evaluation.Agent.run
def run(agent, ignored_goal):
    return original_run(agent, goal)
metadata = {'purpose':'Less-guided tag repair; synthetic fixture, not real-project acceptance',
            'goal':goal, 'harness_digest':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'approval_policy':'Unchanged approve_tags fixed AST variants; no arbitrary-project approval'}
(base/'investigation.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print('OUTPUT', base, flush=True)
with patch.object(evaluation.Agent, 'run', run):
    result = evaluation.evaluate_multifile(base, model, model.model, model_digest, code_digest, suite='tags')
raise SystemExit(result)
